title: Hinomori Shiho — Profile Story

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you...
I'm Shiho Hinomori, the bassist for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As for my self-intro... What should I talk about?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess I'll do what Ichika did and talk about something I like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm happiest when I'm playing my bass.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I feel at ease when it's in my hands, and I can go all out during shows as a result.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I'm truly happy about us signing with a label. Partly because it's always been my dream...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But also because I get to keep playing my bass, and most importantly—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get more chances to put on performances that really move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, Saki, quit heckling me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Though, I think you're all really cool too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you all made the commitment to join me in my dream of going pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, that's been an important goal...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But us playing in a band together means just as much to me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I think you're all really cool for working so hard to make this happen, and I couldn't be more grateful to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what's with that look...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I'm not saying it.
It loses its value if you say it too much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, are we done?
Anything else you need me to say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What? A taste of what's to come...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
I've achieved my dream of going pro...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But my goal remains the same. I want to put on performances that really move people's hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna keep trying to do that as we play our music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The four of us. Together.
